title: Gateway launch variant for local profiles on the claude harness
summary: Add a second validated launch class to the kit's dispatch adapter so the natural standard-band route {claude, local-code-standard} becomes launchable: claude driven against the agentgateway Anthropic-compatible endpoint with the catalog-1.6.0 validated per-process variables (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN resolved at launch from a 1Password reference, ANTHROPIC_MODEL pinned to the catalog physical id, ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS carrying the verbatim /v1/place x-placement header, CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS from the catalog min_context). Extends the native-reachability guard (PR #25) with a fail-closed discriminator from the stamp plus the trusted catalog, mirrors the capability in the readiness library, updates the lifecycle contract doc, and adds pure and stubbed-integration regression coverage including a sentinel-based proof that the credential value never reaches command text, titles, logs or artifacts. The native subscription launch must stay byte-identical. The worker edits the credential-sanitizer boundary of the launch path and designs the credential conveyance mechanism under hard constraints: a plausible-but-wrong result leaks a token or silently runs the wrong provider on the wrong funding pool. Several large files are rewritten (dispatch.sh ~730 lines, run-tests.sh, the readiness library, its test suite, the contract doc).
